name: Shipment of Boots
summary: Along the Barrens coast, the Shipment of Boots remains in a Southsea encampment south of Ratchet. Drizzlik sent the crate from Booty Bay for Gazlowe's trade network, but pirates seized it before it reached port.

sections.title: A Plundered Cargo
sections.body: Gazlowe arranged for Drizzlik, a clothing merchant in Booty Bay, to send boots to Ratchet. Southsea Freebooters ambushed the ship while patrolling the Merchant Coast. They carried the crates to beach encampments south of the harbor and scattered the stolen goods among their tents and shanties. The shipment remains there, far from Ratchet's docks.

faq.q: Who sent this shipment of boots?
aliases: where did the boots come from
faq.answer: Drizzlik, a goblin merchant in Booty Bay, sent the boots from the southern port.

faq.q: Who was supposed to receive the boots?
faq.answer: Gazlowe ordered the boots for Ratchet. He is the chief engineer and overseer there, and the shipment was meant to support his local workforce and trade.

faq.q: How did the boots end up with the pirates?
aliases: why do southsea pirates have boots
faq.answer: Southsea Freebooters ambushed the cargo ship along the Barrens coast. They plundered it and carried the crates to their encampments south of Ratchet.

faq.q: Where can the shipment be found?
faq.answer: The shipment lies among plundered goods in the Southsea pirate encampment along the coast south of Ratchet.

angles.text: As a rogue, you can slip through the Southsea camps along the coast. Pirate patrols are dense, so a silent approach is safest when reclaiming Gazlowe's stolen freight.
